item.name: List Search Interface Configurations in a Project

query.description: A substring that must appear in a search interface configuration name for this configuration to appear in results.

The sort direction of the results.
Possible values:
- `asc`: ascending order
- `desc`: descending order
The 0-based number of the page of configurations to list.
The maximum number of configurations to include per page.
The id of the project to which the resource belongs.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

request.description: Lists the search interface configurations in a [Coveo organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/) and a [project](https://docs.coveo.com/en/n7ef0517/manage-an-organization/manage-projects).
